concerns.text: SC-007 requires a documented power analysis before data generation. Task T059 is marked as unimplemented (`- [ ]`) and explicitly states it MUST run BEFORE T021 and T026. Without this task completed, the study lacks the required sample size justification, blocking the execution of the primary kinetic analysis (US-2).

SC-002 requires verifying consistent trends across ≥5 solvent conditions. Task T048 (Trend Verification) is marked as unimplemented (`- [ ]`). No other task in the plan performs the specific logic of aggregating lifetimes by solvent and verifying monotonicity/significance as required by the success criterion.

SC-010 requires logged dielectric constants to match the versioned lookup table for ≥98% of solvents. Task T017a (Environmental Validation) is unimplemented (`- [ ]`) and relies on T006d (Hash Generation) which is also unimplemented (`- [ ]`). The chain of tasks required to validate and report compliance (T006d -> T017a -> T017b) is broken.

FR-007 and SC-004 require logging environmental parameters (temp, humidity, pressure) and reporting compliance. Task T014 (Environment Logging) is unimplemented (`- [ ]`), preventing the generation of `environment_logs.json` required for downstream validation and US-1 acceptance.

FR-002 requires capturing transient-absorption data. Task T015 (Synthetic Generation) is unimplemented (`- [ ]`) and T015b (Real Data) is blocked by missing hardware. While T015b has a fallback, the primary CI path (T015) is missing, leaving no verifiable path to produce the dataset required for US-1 and US-2.

Task T055 (Ground-State Characterization) is unimplemented (`- [ ]`). While the spec mentions ground-state characterization in Edge Cases, the specific task to generate the baseline spectra (required for distinguishing solvent effects from artifacts per Rosalind Franklin review) is not marked as complete, creating a gap in the experimental control documentation.
